name: Web deploy
# Builds the production web app on GitHub's free runners (this repository is
# public) and uploads the prebuilt output to Vercel, instead of paying for
# Vercel build minutes. Vercel's own Git deployment of main is off in
# vercel.json. See docs/operations/web-deploy.md.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runtime-refresh:
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime-worker-sha:
        type: string
        default: ''
      runtime-template-models:
        type: string
        default: '{}'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  deploy:
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    concurrency:
      # Keep newer main jobs queued even if an older runtime validation finishes
      # later. Queue order is not commit order; the main guards reject stale jobs.
      group: web-deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
      queue: max
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: team_C7lwxVVvnUicFli6112mvxpv
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: prj_VdNz3P0FmuRbZKeI40hbCqwR0NVH
      VERCEL_CLI: vercel@65.4.0
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
      # Same as vercel.json build.env.
      NEXT_ENABLE_ADAPTER: '0'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: 10.34.3
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Refuse an obsolete source before release work
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Read the Vercel deploy token
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /platform
          secret-name: VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN
          include-imports: false
      - name: Skip documentation-only changes
        id: skip
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs skip
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ env.VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          RUNTIME_REFRESH: ${{ inputs.runtime-refresh }}
      - name: Read the existing Vercel runtime release token
        if: inputs.runtime-refresh == true
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /platform
          secret-name: VERCEL_TEAM_TOKEN
          include-imports: false
      - name: Publish the verified official runtime pair inside the deployment queue
        if: inputs.runtime-refresh == true
        run: node scripts/e2b/publish-template-env.mjs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          DESKTOP_TEMPLATE_ID: desktop
          CLAUDE_TEMPLATE_ID: claude
          CODEX_TEMPLATE_ID: codex
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime-worker-sha }}
          MIKKA_CLOUD_WORKER_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.sha }}
          TEMPLATE_MODELS: ${{ inputs.runtime-template-models }}
      # `vercel pull` returns Vercel's sensitive values empty. prod:/vercel is the
      # Infisical source Vercel production is synced from; the next step fills only
      # keys production defines and Vercel withheld. Runtime still reads Vercel's copy.
      - name: Read the production values Vercel withholds from `vercel pull`
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          recursive: false
          include-imports: false
      - name: Pull the production project settings and environment
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: npx --yes "$VERCEL_CLI" pull --yes --environment=production --token "$VERCEL_TOKEN" > /dev/null
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ env.VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
      - name: Fill build-time values
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs env .vercel/.env.production.local
      - name: Build (runs migrations last, as the Vercel build did)
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: npx --yes "$VERCEL_CLI" build --prod --token "$VERCEL_TOKEN"
        env:
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ env.VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
          VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF: main
          VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Upload the prebuilt output to production
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: |
          node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs main
          message="$(git log -1 --format=%s "$GITHUB_SHA")"
          url="$(npx --yes "$VERCEL_CLI" deploy --prebuilt --prod --archive=tgz --token "$VERCEL_TOKEN" \
            --meta githubDeployment=1 --meta githubOrg=alexj11324 --meta githubRepo=Mikka \
            --meta githubCommitRef=main --meta githubCommitSha="$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --meta githubCommitMessage="$message")"
          echo "Deployed $url"
          echo "### Production deployment" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "$url (commit $GITHUB_SHA)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ env.VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify the public production version before releasing the deployment queue
        if: steps.skip.outputs.skip != 'true'
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs verify

name: E2B official instance runtime
# The historical e2b-template.yml remains disabled and unchanged. This workflow
# only creates disposable official instances and publishes matching app config.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: &runtime_paths
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'packages/daemon/**'
      - 'packages/protocol/**'
      - 'packages/config/**'
      - 'patches/**'
      - 'scripts/e2b/**'
      - 'scripts/e2b/publish-template-env.mjs'
      - 'lib/computer/official-runtime.ts'
      - '.github/workflows/e2b-official-runtime.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/web-deploy.yml'
      - 'scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs'
      - 'scripts/release/web-deploy.test.mjs'
      # This issue's acceptance requires a same-application-SHA runtime proof.
      - '.github/workflows/model-provider-fallback-acceptance.yml'
      - 'scripts/acceptance/model-provider-fallback.mjs'
      - 'scripts/acceptance/model-provider-fallback.test.mjs'
      - '.github/workflows/project-decisions-acceptance.yml'
      - 'scripts/acceptance/project-decisions.mjs'
      - 'scripts/acceptance/project-decisions.test.mjs'
  pull_request:
    paths: *runtime_paths
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runtime-refresh:
        description: Validate and publish even when the configured worker hash matches
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('e2b-official-runtime-{0}', github.ref) || 'e2b-official-runtime-release' }}
  # An old rerun must not replace the latest main's pending runtime validation.
  # PRs have their own group and only run the offline test job; retain those too.
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: node --test scripts/e2b/publish-template-env.test.mjs scripts/e2b/cloud-acceptance-release.test.mjs scripts/release/web-deploy.test.mjs
      - run: python3 -m py_compile scripts/e2b/validate-official-instances.py
      - run: bash -n packages/daemon/scripts/official-e2b-instance-bootstrap.sh
  # Unchanged runtime content skips validation unless its release-control path
  # changed in this push, or an operator explicitly requested a full refresh.
  check:
    needs: test
    if: github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.compare.outputs.changed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Refuse an obsolete source before runtime validation
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Check publication-control changes across this push
        id: control
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs runtime-refresh
        env:
          RUNTIME_REFRESH: ${{ inputs.runtime-refresh }}
      - name: Read the Vercel team token through Infisical workload identity
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /platform
          secret-name: VERCEL_TEAM_TOKEN
          include-imports: false
      - name: Compare the worker hash with production
        id: compare
        run: |
          wanted="$(python3 scripts/e2b/build-template.py --worker-hash --source-ref "$GITHUB_SHA")"
          live="$(node scripts/e2b/publish-template-env.mjs --current)"
          echo "worker hash $wanted; production $live"
          if [ "$RUNTIME_REFRESH" = true ] || [ "$wanted" != "$live" ]; then echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; else echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
        env:
          RUNTIME_REFRESH: ${{ steps.control.outputs.refresh }}
  validate:
    needs: [test, check]
    if: needs.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      source-sha: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.source-sha }}
      template-models: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.template-models }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the pinned E2B SDK
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2b"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2b/bin/pip" install --disable-pip-version-check 'e2b==2.62.0'
      - name: Read the existing E2B validation key
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: prod
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: E2B_API_KEY
          include-imports: false
      - name: Validate new official instances without template mutation
        id: validate
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/e2b/bin/python" scripts/e2b/validate-official-instances.py --source-ref "$GITHUB_SHA" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-runtime.json"
          node --input-type=module - "$RUNNER_TEMP/official-runtime.json" <<'JS'
          import { readFileSync, appendFileSync } from 'node:fs'
          const report = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'))
          if (report.sourceCommit !== process.env.GITHUB_SHA || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(report.workerSha)) throw Error('Runtime source mismatch')
          const models = {}
          for (const kind of ['desktop', 'claude', 'codex']) {
            const row = report.templates[kind]
            if (row.templateId !== kind || JSON.stringify(row.before) !== JSON.stringify(row.after)) throw Error('Official files changed')
            models[kind] = row.models
            console.log(`${kind}: ${row.before.entries} preserved entries, manifest ${row.before.sha256}`)
          }
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `source-sha=${report.workerSha}\ntemplate-models=${JSON.stringify(models)}\n`)
          JS
  # Do not take web-deploy-production here: the matching Web job needs that
  # queue to finish its GitHub build and upload while this read-only job waits.
  await-web:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Await this source's actual Web build and public version
        run: node scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs await-web
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  publish:
    needs: [validate, await-web]
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/web-deploy.yml
    with:
      runtime-refresh: true
      runtime-worker-sha: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.source-sha }}
      runtime-template-models: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.template-models }}

# Production web deploy

Production builds of the web app run on GitHub Actions, not on Vercel's build
machines. Mikka is a public repository, so GitHub's standard runners are free,
while each Vercel build cost about 5 minutes of a 4-core machine, around 100
times a day. Vercel still hosts the deployment and serves `app.aspectlylabs.com`.

## Flow

`.github/workflows/web-deploy.yml` runs on every push to `main`, on manual
dispatch, and as the reusable build for a verified official runtime refresh.
Its deploy job holds `web-deploy-production` through environment publication,
build, upload and public-version verification. `queue: max` retains pending
jobs instead of allowing a late old runtime refresh to replace a queued new
main deploy. The queue orders jobs by when they start waiting, not by commit
order; source guards reject jobs whose full SHA is no longer current `main`.
See [GitHub's concurrency contract](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/control-workflow-concurrency).

1. **Source and token.** Checks the current `main` SHA before release work,
   then reads `VERCEL_DEPLOY_TOKEN` from Infisical `prod:/platform`
   through the existing GitHub OIDC identity. This is a dedicated Mikka-team
   token, so it can be rotated without touching `VERCEL_TOKEN` or
   `VERCEL_TEAM_TOKEN`. It expires on 2027-02-02.
2. **Skip.** Applies the same documentation-only rule the old Vercel Ignored
   Build Step used (`scripts/vercel-ignore-build.mjs`). The comparison is
   against the commit production serves now, not the previous push, so a
   failed deploy is never skipped over.
3. **Environment.**
   - `vercel pull` fetches project settings and the production environment.
     Vercel returns sensitive values empty.
   - The job reads `prod:/vercel` from Infisical. This is the source that
     Vercel production is synced from.
   - `scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs env` fills only the keys that production
     defines and Vercel withheld. It pins `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF=main` and the
     commit SHA, which the migration guard requires.
   - It refuses to build if a required value is missing. The error names the
     variable, never its value.
4. **Build.** Runs `vercel build --prod`, which is the same `pnpm build` as
   before, ending with typecheck and then migrations against the production
   database.
5. **Deploy.** Rechecks current `main` immediately before
   `vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod`. The Git metadata (org,
   repo, ref, SHA) lets the device gateway release
   (`docs/operations/device-gateway-release.md`) identify the serving commit.
6. **Verify.** Before releasing the queue, requires the unauthenticated public
   `/mikka/api/version` response's `build` to equal the complete commit SHA.

The deployment's runtime environment comes from the Vercel project as before.
The workflow uploads build output only.

`vercel.json` keeps `git.deploymentEnabled.main` off, so Vercel does not also
build each push.

## Official runtime configuration

The official runtime workflow keeps its existing disposable-instance validation,
worker hash, measured model catalogue and unchanged-file proofs. After validation,
a read-only job waits up to 40 minutes for the same source's latest Web run to
succeed, including its actual build/upload/version steps, and for the public
version to match. A docs-only skipped build cannot satisfy this gate. If `main`
advances, the old release stops. This wait is outside the shared deployment queue
so it cannot block the Web job it is waiting for.

Changes to the two release workflows, `scripts/release/web-deploy.mjs` or
`scripts/e2b/publish-template-env.mjs` also require the full runtime validation
and reusable publication, even when the worker hash is unchanged. The check
compares the actual complete push (`github.event.before` to `github.sha`) with
full history; missing or invalid endpoints fail instead of counting as unchanged.
These four paths are all in the runtime workflow's push filter. Documentation
and test-only changes do not force paid instance validation.

The E2B caller itself also uses a distinct `queue: max` group, so an old rerun
cannot discard a newer main's pending validation before it reaches Web deploy.
The check rejects obsolete main jobs before reading release credentials or
starting instance validation. PRs keep their separate group and only run offline
tests; retaining their pending runs replaces the previous cancellation behavior
at the cost of possibly running an obsolete, short offline test job.

The runtime workflow then calls `web-deploy.yml` at its own commit with
`runtime-refresh: true`. Inside the shared deploy job, the original Infisical
identity reads the existing `VERCEL_TEAM_TOKEN`. The publisher verifies current
`main`, the production alias and public version, reads the six runtime values,
checks `main` again, and submits at most one environment upsert followed by exact
readback. The ordinary GitHub build and prebuilt upload follow in that same job.
The publisher does not create a Vercel deployment or request a source rebuild.

If env publication succeeds but the later build fails, use Actions' **Re-run
failed jobs** on that runtime run while its source is still current `main`. It
reuses the successful validation outputs. The explicit runtime refresh builds
even when the env values already match; it also bypasses the docs-only skip.
An uncertain environment POST is never automatically retried. A failed-job rerun
reads back before deciding whether one new upsert is needed. Re-running the
entire runtime workflow with the default inputs is different: its initial
worker-hash comparison can skip validation/publication when the env hash already
matches. For a full refresh or a release-pipeline acceptance, manually dispatch
**E2B official instance runtime** on current `main` with `runtime-refresh: true`
after its Web run and public version match. That explicit option only bypasses
the unchanged-hash optimization; it runs the official-instance validation again
and preserves all source, measured-model, queue and readback checks. It defaults
to false, so ordinary unchanged pushes keep their existing skip behavior.

The source fences and queue protect application upload order; they do not make
the Git ref and Vercel environment one atomic transaction. A newer push during
the build prevents the obsolete upload. Its normal main release proceeds next.

## Logs are public

Actions logs on this repository are public. Infisical values are masked by the
action, and `vercel pull` output is discarded. Do not add steps that print the
environment or `.vercel/.env.production.local`.

## Rollback

Fix forward in a new PR, or revert through a PR. The resulting `main` commit
uses the same GitHub build, prebuilt upload and public-version verification.
Do not restore Vercel source builds, delete deployments or revoke shared tokens
as a recovery step.
